name: Prepare, lodge and chase council approvals and permits
summary: Prepares, lodges and chases council approvals and permits. Every hour it reads the open markups and RFI-style requests on each approval document in Bluebeam Studio and records where each stands. Every day it keeps a dated snapshot of each document for the record. The crons only read and draft; lodging with council, answering council and any status change that someone outside the business sees stay with a person.

covered_by.prepare-plans: skill (drafters and certifiers do the work outside the business)
covered_by.respond-rfi: skill (RFI markups are listed by track-status; a person answers council)

crons.name: track-status
crons.summary: Read the open markups and RFI-style requests on each approval document and record where each one stands.

crons.name: record-keeping
crons.summary: Start one dated snapshot of each approval document for the record (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads of the Studio session, and a dated snapshot of a document kept in the session. Nothing here changes a markup status, answers council or lodges anything.

bluebeam.covers: approval documents in Bluebeam Studio: open markups and RFI-style requests, valid statuses, dated snapshots

gaps: Council portals and counters: lodgement, forms, fees and council requests for information arrive by portal, email or post. No platform in the kit maps them, so a person does these steps.
Procore: its help pages describe RFIs for the project team, but the kit has no Procore platform, so there is no adapter. Build one from the endpoint map before wiring it.
Microsoft 365: its docs describe Office accessibility, not approvals or permits. No adapter.

Changing a markup status (SessionMarkups_UpdateStatus) is not wired. The spec gives only two body fields, Model and State, and does not say what each means. A live Bluebeam account needs to confirm this before any cron queues a status change.
Bluebeam is mapped from its public API and has not been run against a real account. The markup and status response shapes are taken from the spec, not a live call.
Chasing council or consultants has no messaging platform mapped for this job, so it stays manual.
Consultant coordination, conditions tracking and client updates have no mapped platform. They stay with the person, with the skill drafting notes only.
